text:
sophia (prod-designer): Heads-up: during demo today people interpreted the preview "slabs" as progress bars. With 8+ rules it reads dense and noisy. Can we try a lighter visual treatment and clearer labeling?
jas (frontend): Yep. My quick idea: reduce slab visual thickness, move percent labels outside to the right, and reserve color only for the fill not the background.
ravi (pm): Also the validation phrase 'Overlap' felt non-actionable from support calls. Need a template that tells the user which rules and what to change.
nate (engineer): Implementation constraint: we need to keep a minimum interactive area for drag handles (44px) even if the bar is visually small. That's a touch size law.
a11ybot: :warning: Contrast audit: current accent-green (#27AE60) over 12px white overlay fails 4.5:1. Recommend swapping to accent-800 or using neutral-900 for small text.
sophia (prod-designer): Good call. I'll swap to tokens that pass contrast. Proposal for header copy: 'Preview simulated routing (est. req/min)'. Tooltip: 'Weights are relative; toggle to absolute sample rate.'
jas (frontend): For CSS I'll set vars: `--preview-bar-visual: 6px; --preview-handle-area: 44px; --preview-gap: 10px;`. I can keep invisible padding to maintain hit area.
ravi (pm): Proposed rewording for overlap: "Rule 'Beta' overlaps 'Default' — make targets exclusive or lower priority." Keep it short and prescriptive.
nate (engineer): Perf: compute percentages client-side and memoize by stable rule id. Use `Math.round((w / total) * 100)` to avoid fractional noise. Also avoid layout thrash by not reading DOM after writes.
a11ybot: :white_check_mark: Accessibility checks: add aria-live="assertive" for validation errors and ensure keyboard reorder focus is preserved when the preview overlay toggles. Also ensure focus ring remains visible on overlay.
sophia (prod-designer): UX detail: tiny info icon next to each weight that expands a tooltip showing the formula and an example like "30% ≈ 30 req/min". Also toggle for absolute vs percent view.
jas (frontend): I'll prototype the outside-right percent and preserve left invisible drag area. Fix keyboard focus issue at the same time. Expect PR tomorrow.
ravi (pm): Who owns the microcopy final pass? I can consolidate, would like eng to sanity-check length for tooltips.
nate (engineer): I'll pair for 20 mins after standup to check IDs and tooltip aria attributes.
sophia (prod-designer): I'll push updated frames to Figma and include color swaps for contrast. I'll paste the link here once uploaded. Thanks! :sparkles:
